# bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/editconf

## Summary

Wrapper class for the GROMACS editconf module.

The GROMACS editconf converts generic structure format to .gro, .g96 or .pdb.

Nextflow adapter of the [Editconf](https://biobb-gromacs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.editconf) building block of [biobb_gromacs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_gromacs) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_GROMACS_EDITCONF } from 'bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/editconf'

workflow {
    BIOBB_GROMACS_EDITCONF(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_gro_path` | yes | gro, pdb | Path to the input GRO file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_gro_path` | yes | pdb, gro | Path to the output GRO file |
| `versions_biobb_gromacs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_gromacs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Editconf properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_gro_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_gromacs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_GROMACS_EDITCONF' {
        ext.properties = [box_type: 'cubic']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `distance_to_molecule` | number | 1.0 | Distance of the box from the outermost atom in nm. ie 1.0nm = 10 Angstroms. |
| `box_vector_lenghts` | string | null | Array of floats defining the box vector lenghts ie "0.5 0.5 0.5". If this option is used the distance_to_molecule property will be ignored. |
| `box_type` | string | "cubic" | Geometrical shape of the solvent box. Values: cubic, triclinic, dodecahedron, octahedron. |
| `center_molecule` | boolean | true | Center molecule in the box. |
| `gmx_lib` | string | null | Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
